happens to one merchant in one segment" style="text;html=1;fontSize=20;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="0" width="760" height="40" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="a" value="Merchant enters segment<br><font style="font-size: 13px">its trigger event</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=16;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="35" y="60" width="160" height="60" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="h" value="Holdout?" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=16;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="35" y="180" width="160" height="90" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="g" value="Ghost send<br><font style="font-size: 13px">nothing is sent</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=16;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="230" y="180" width="150" height="60" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="bl" value="Counts toward<br><font style="font-size: 13px">the baseline</font>" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=16;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="230" y="300" width="150" height="60" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="p" value="Scorer picks<br><font style="font-size: 13px">subject · body · timing · offer</font>" id="wt" value="Wait for the timing<br><font style="font-size: 13px">and the 48h gap</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=16;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="35" y="420" width="160" height="60" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="st" value="Still in segment?" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=16;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="35" y="540" width="160" height="90" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="sk" value="Skipped<br><font style="font-size: 13px">and counted</font>" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=16;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="230" y="540" width="150" height="60" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="se" value="Send the email" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=16;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="420" y="60" width="150" height="60" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="hc" value="Human click?" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=16;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="415" y="180" width="160" height="90" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="us" value="Update scores<br><font style="font-size: 13px">subject + body</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=16;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="610" y="180" width="150" height="60" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="fx" value="Wait fixed days<br><font style="font-size: 13px">8 / 12 / 14 from trigger</font>" id="ut" value="Update scores<br><font style="font-size: 13px">timing + offer (goal, revenue)</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=16;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;"
